description: Look up CIDR ranges, ASN number/name, organisation, and registration dates for an IP address, ASN, or organisation name. Use this when investigating who owns a chunk of address space or what netblocks an organisation controls. Do NOT use this for point-in-time geolocation of a single IP (use `ipgeolocation`) or to enumerate domains on the IP (use `reverse_ip`).

from_needle.description: Pagination needle from previous page's "inetnum" response.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to search.

netmask_value.description: Netmask value: 0-32 for IPv4, 0-128 for IPv6.

name: ip_netblocks
